integrity: The proof derives the exact graph decomposition from Burnside basis theory, classifies every minimum forcing set, constructs exact real bilinear-form witnesses in ranks one through three, and proves the rank-two obstruction for multipartite parts of size at least three.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite noncyclic p-groups with minimal generator number two.
The minimum-rank statement is over real symmetric matrices.
The bare complete-multipartite zero forcing value is standard; the strengthened content is the generating-pair classification, polynomial recovery, and minimum-rank phase transition.
The 2013 finite-soluble-group source was accessible through abstract/repository material rather than inspected full text.
title: Zero forcing in generating graphs of two-generated finite p-groups
